lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The amendment is read at forty past the hour to a chamber that is mostly empty and entirely bought. It carries by three votes, because three people were bored.

lines.speaker: mara_vesely
lines.text: A cession must name its beneficiary. Twelve words. Nobody in here understands what they have just made impossible.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In my century the Steward's charter has an owner clause nobody can find the origin of. That was it. That was you.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Twelve words. Two hundred years. I'm going to need a minute with that.
